description:
I'm Del Rasmussen. I grew up in a Minnesota farmhouse where the power went out every hard winter, and I spent 34 years behind the counter of a small-town hardware store watching what really works when things go wrong — and what people waste their money on. This channel is the cheap, old-timer know-how that keeps a house warm, fed and safe when the grid, the weather or the prices turn against you. No fear-selling. 

Del Rasmussen is a fictional narrator. Every video is researched from public sources (FEMA, Red Cross, CDC). Always follow your local emergency guidance.
